column21: REGIME SPLIT (Q90, 2026-07-24). 2010–2012 = EEG 2009 §§40–44 + §6 AusglMechV: flat 0.05 ct/kWh cap on the privileged volume, with a 10% SELBSTBEHALT at the full Umlage UNLESS the site clears BOTH ≥100 GWh AND ≥20% Stromkosten/Bruttowertschöpfung (§41(3) S.1 — the limbs are joined by "oder", so failing either brings the Selbstbehalt back). The large archetype (500 GWh) is modelled vollbegünstigt, so 0.05 ct/kWh across the whole volume = 0.5 €/MWh, unchanged 2010–2012. 2013+ = EEG 2012 §41(3) tranche ladder (≤1 GWh full / 1–10 GWh 10% / 10–100 GWh 1% / >100 GWh 0.05 ct), then EEG 2014/2017/2021 §64 floors 0.05 (cap assumed binding — typical large EII; est=Y). CRITICAL TIMING: the EEG 2012 ladder FIRST APPLIES TO BENEFIT YEAR 2013, not 2012 — §43(1) makes applications due 30 June effective 1 January of the FOLLOWING year, and §66(13) EEG 2012 applies §41 to applications made IN 2012. Benefit year 2012 ran on applications filed 30.06.2011 under EEG 2009. Empirical confirmation: privileged undertakings 734 (2012) → 1,691 (2013) when the 1 GWh threshold bit. S189/S191. High-band 2013+: =(1+0.15×499)/500×Umlage.
